claim: Hong Kong Macau cultural student exchange was a trip that tested Macau national security law who's purpose was to fulfil Article 23 of the Macau Basic Law for national safety.
evidencia:

Page: Hong Kong Macau cultural exchange. Sentence: The goal was to have Pan-democracy camp members test the newly enacted Macau national security law by going from Hong Kong to Macau to see who gets banned.
Page: Macau national security law. Sentence: The Macau's national security law (, Portuguese: Lei relative à defesa da segurança do Estado) is a law in Macau which prohibits and punishes acts of "treason, secession, and subversion" against the Central government, as well as "preparatory acts" leading to any of the three acts.
Page: Macau national security law. Sentence: Taken into effect on 3 March 2009, the purpose of the law is to fulfil Article 23 of the Macau Basic Law, the constitutional document of the Macau Special Administration Region.

Facts:
- The Macau national security law took effect on 3 March 2009 in Macau.
- The purpose of the Macau national security law was to fulfill Article 23 of the Macau Basic Law, the constitutional document of the Macau Special Administrative Region.
- The Macau national security law prohibits and punishes treason, secession, and subversion against the Central Government, as well as preparatory acts leading to those acts.
- The Hong Kong Macau cultural exchange took place on the Sunday morning of 15 March 2009.
- The goal of the Hong Kong Macau cultural exchange was for Pan-democracy camp members to travel from Hong Kong to Macau to test the newly enacted Macau national security law by seeing who would be banned.
